audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph public succession charge and temple plans, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for public succession pressure, David's bloodshed, chosen-king language, conditional covenant, heart-searching, Solomon's youth, spiritualized architectural plans, material weights, skilled labor, royal command, and sanctuary symbolism.

verses.restored: David assembled at Jerusalem all leaders of Israel: tribal leaders, division commanders serving king, commanders of thousands and hundreds, officials over all property and livestock of king and sons, court officials, mighty warriors, and every able person.
King David stood on feet and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build resting house for ark of covenant of YHWH and footstool of our Divine, and I prepared to build.
But Divine said to me, You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of wars and have shed blood.

Yet YHWH Divine of Israel chose me from all father's house to be king over Israel enduringly; chose Judah as leader, house of Judah, house of my father, and among father's sons delighted to make me king over all Israel.
From all my sons—for YHWH gave me many sons—YHWH chose Solomon my son to sit on throne of kingdom of YHWH over Israel.
YHWH said to me, Solomon your son shall build my house and courts, for I have chosen him as son and I will be father to him.
I will establish his kingdom enduringly if he is strong to do my commandments and judgments, as this day.

Now, before eyes of all Israel, assembly of YHWH, and in hearing of our Divine, guard and seek all commandments of YHWH your Divine, so you may possess good land and leave it as inheritance to children after you enduringly.

You, Solomon my son, know Divine of your father and serve with whole heart and willing soul, for YHWH searches all hearts and understands every formation of thoughts. If you seek, you will find; if you abandon, you will be rejected enduringly.
See now, for YHWH has chosen you to build a house for sanctuary. Be strong and act.
David gave Solomon pattern for porch, buildings, treasuries, upper rooms, inner rooms, and room for atonement-cover.
Also pattern of all that was with him by spirit for courts of house of YHWH, surrounding chambers, treasuries of house of Divine, and treasuries of dedicated things;
for divisions of priests and Levites, all work of service of house of YHWH, and all vessels for service.
Gold by weight for things of gold for every service; silver by weight for all silver vessels for every service;
weight for gold lampstands and lamps, each lampstand and lamps by service; and silver lampstands by weight according to service.
Gold by weight for tables of rows, table by table; silver for silver tables;
pure gold for forks, bowls, and cups; gold by weight for each golden basin and silver by weight for each silver basin;
refined gold by weight for incense altar, and pattern for chariot—the golden cherubim spreading wings and covering ark of covenant of YHWH.
All this, David said, was in writing from hand of YHWH upon me, giving insight into all works of pattern.

David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and courageous and act; do not fear or be dismayed, for YHWH Divine, my Divine, is with you. YHWH will not fail or abandon you until all work for service of house of YHWH is finished.
Look, divisions of priests and Levites for all service of house of Divine; with you for all work are every willing person skilled in every craft, and officials and all people are at your command.

translation_notes: The succession and temple commission occur before a massive public assembly, creating intense pressure on Solomon to accept a role chosen by father and institution.
David again states that warfare and bloodshed disqualify him from building; chosen status does not erase this moral limit.
Claims that David, Judah, and Solomon are chosen belong to ancient covenantal theology and do not create hereditary divine right or immunity.
The kingdom promise is explicitly conditional upon justice and commandments, despite idealizing language.
Divine heart-searching is a theological claim, not permission for leaders to surveil thoughts, demand disclosure, or control conscience.
The plans are attributed to spirit and writing. Spiritual inspiration does not replace architecture, engineering, fire safety, accessibility, labor law, budgets, and independent review.
Detailed gold and silver weights expose immense wealth and resource concentration.
Cherubim and chariot imagery are sacred symbolism, not occult or mechanical instructions.
Workers are described as willing and skilled, yet also placed at Solomon's command; true willingness must remain revocable and protected from royal coercion.
The assembly includes property and military officials but does not demonstrate broad participation by women, poor people, workers, or prior inhabitants.
safety_note: Do not use chosen status, heart-searching, spiritual blueprints, royal command, or temple grandeur to justify authoritarianism, surveillance, unsafe design, coerced labor, or leader cult. Center Solomon's youth and consent, David's disqualification, workers' freedom, accessibility, engineering, and financial accountability.
